title: Relay Anatomy
learning_objective: Identify coil A1/A2, COM, NO, and NC terminals. NO is open until coil is energized.
story_text: Your first job: label the terminals on this relay so the next tech knows what's what.

common_mistakes.explanation: The lamp is on NC, so it is lit when the relay is OFF.

hints: A1 and A2 are the coil. COM is the common moving contact.
